text.KJV: And this house, which is high, shall be an astonishment to every one that passeth by it; so that he shall say, Why hath the LORD done thus unto this land, and unto this house?
text.ASV: And this house, which is so high, every one that passeth by it shall be astonished, and shall say, Why hath Jehovah done thus unto this land, and to this house?
text.WEB: This house, which is so high, everyone who passes by it shall be astonished, and shall say, ‘Why has Yahweh done this to this land and to this house?’

text.KJV: And it shall be answered, Because they forsook the LORD God of their fathers, which brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, and laid hold on other gods, and worshipped them, and served them: therefore hath he brought all this evil upon them.
text.ASV: And they shall answer, Because they forsook Jehovah, the God of their fathers, who brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, and laid hold on other gods, and worshipped them, and served them: therefore hath he brought all this evil upon them.
text.WEB: They shall answer, ‘Because they abandoned Yahweh, the God of their fathers, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, and took other gods, worshiped them, and served them. Therefore he has brought all this evil on them.’”

text.KJV: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, wherein Solomon had built the house of the LORD, and his own house,
text.ASV: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, wherein Solomon had built the house of Jehovah, and his own house,
text.WEB: At the end of twenty years, in which Solomon had built Yahweh’s house and his own house,

text.KJV: That the cities which Huram had restored to Solomon, Solomon built them, and caused the children of Israel to dwell there.
text.ASV: that the cities which Huram had given to Solomon, Solomon built them, and caused the children of Israel to dwell there.
text.WEB: Solomon built the cities which Huram had given to Solomon, and caused the children of Israel to dwell there.

text.KJV: And Solomon went to Hamathzobah, and prevailed against it.
text.ASV: And Solomon went to Hamath-zobah, and prevailed against it.
text.WEB: Solomon went to Hamath Zobah, and prevailed against it.

text.KJV: And he built Tadmor in the wilderness, and all the store cities, which he built in Hamath.
text.ASV: And he built Tadmor in the wilderness, and all the store-cities, which he built in Hamath.
text.WEB: He built Tadmor in the wilderness, and all the storage cities, which he built in Hamath.

text.KJV: Also he built Bethhoron the upper, and Bethhoron the nether, fenced cities, with walls, gates, and bars;
text.ASV: Also he built Beth-horon the upper, and Beth-horon the nether, fortified cities, with walls, gates, and bars;
text.WEB: Also he built Beth Horon the upper and Beth Horon the lower, fortified cities, with walls, gates, and bars;

text.KJV: And Baalath, and all the store cities that Solomon had, and all the chariot cities, and the cities of the horsemen, and all that Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and throughout all the land of his dominion.
text.ASV: and Baalath, and all the store-cities that Solomon had, and all the cities for his chariots, and the cities for his horsemen, and all that Solomon desired to build for his pleasure in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.
text.WEB: and Baalath, and all the storage cities that Solomon had, and all the cities for his chariots, the cities for his horsemen, and all that Solomon desired to build for his pleasure in Jerusalem, in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.

text.KJV: As for all the people that were left of the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, which were not of Israel,
text.ASV: As for all the people that were left of the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, that were not of Israel;
text.WEB: As for all the people who were left of the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, who were not of Israel;

text.KJV: But of their children, who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel consumed not, them did Solomon make to pay tribute until this day.
text.ASV: of their children that were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel consumed not, of them did Solomon raise a levy `of bondservants' unto this day.
text.WEB: of their children who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel didn’t consume, of them Solomon conscripted forced labor to this day.

text.KJV: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no servants for his work; but they were men of war, and chief of his captains, and captains of his chariots and horsemen.
text.ASV: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no servants for his work; but they were men of war, and chief of his captains, and rulers of his chariots and of his horsemen.
text.WEB: But of the children of Israel, Solomon made no servants for his work; but they were men of war, and chief of his captains, and rulers of his chariots and of his horsemen.

text.KJV: And these were the chief of king Solomon's officers, even two hundred and fifty, that bare rule over the people.
text.ASV: And these were the chief officers of king Solomon, even two hundred and fifty, that bare rule over the people.
text.WEB: These were the chief officers of king Solomon, even two-hundred fifty, who ruled over the people.

text.KJV: And Solomon brought up the daughter of Pharaoh out of the city of David unto the house that he had built for her: for he said, My wife shall not dwell in the house of David king of Israel, because the places are holy, whereunto the ark of the LORD hath come.
text.ASV: And Solomon brought up the daughter of Pharaoh out of the city of David unto the house that he had built for her; for he said, My wife shall not dwell in the house of David king of Israel, because the places are holy, whereunto the ark of Jehovah hath come.
text.WEB: Solomon brought up Pharaoh’s daughter out of David’s city to the house that he had built for her; for he said, “My wife shall not dwell in the house of David king of Israel, because the places where Yahweh’s ark has come are holy.”

text.KJV: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings unto the LORD on the altar of the LORD, which he had built before the porch,
text.ASV: Then Solomon offered burnt-offerings unto Jehovah on the altar of Jehovah, which he had built before the porch,
text.WEB: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings to Yahweh on Yahweh’s altar, which he had built before the porch,

text.KJV: Even after a certain rate every day, offering according to the commandment of Moses, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts, three times in the year, even in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles.
text.ASV: even as the duty of every day required, offering according to the commandment of Moses, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the set feasts, three times in the year, `even' in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles.
text.WEB: even as the duty of every day required, offering according to the commandment of Moses, on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts, three times per year, during the feast of unleavened bread, during the feast of weeks, and during the feast of tents.

text.KJV: And he appointed, according to the order of David his father, the courses of the priests to their service, and the Levites to their charges, to praise and minister before the priests, as the duty of every day required: the porters also by their courses at every gate: for so had David the man of God commanded.
text.ASV: And he appointed, according to the ordinance of David his father, the courses of the priests to their service, and the Levites to their offices, to praise, and to minister before the priests, as the duty of every day required; the doorkeepers also by their courses at every gate: for so had David the man of God commanded.
text.WEB: He appointed, according to the ordinance of David his father, the divisions of the priests to their service, and the Levites to their offices, to praise and to minister before the priests, as the duty of every day required; the doorkeepers also by their divisions at every gate, for David the man of God had so commanded.

text.KJV: And they departed not from the commandment of the king unto the priests and Levites concerning any matter, or concerning the treasures.
text.ASV: And they departed not from the commandment of the king unto the priests and Levites concerning any matter, or concerning the treasures.
text.WEB: They didn’t depart from the commandment of the king to the priests and Levites concerning any matter, or concerning the treasures.

text.KJV: Now all the work of Solomon was prepared unto the day of the foundation of the house of the LORD, and until it was finished. So the house of the LORD was perfected.
text.ASV: Now all the work of Solomon was prepared unto the day of the foundation of the house of Jehovah, and until it was finished. `So' the house of Jehovah was completed.
text.WEB: Now all the work of Solomon was prepared from the day of the foundation of Yahweh’s house until it was finished. So Yahweh’s house was completed.

text.KJV: Then went Solomon to Eziongeber, and to Eloth, at the sea side in the land of Edom.
text.ASV: Then went Solomon to Ezion-geber, and to Eloth, on the seashore in the land of Edom.
text.WEB: Then Solomon went to Ezion Geber and to Eloth, on the seashore in the land of Edom.

text.KJV: And Huram sent him by the hands of his servants ships, and servants that had knowledge of the sea; and they went with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and took thence four hundred and fifty talents of gold, and brought them to king Solomon.
text.ASV: And Huram sent him by the hands of his servants ships, and servants that had knowledge of the sea; and they came with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and fetched from thence four hundred and fifty talents of gold, and brought them to king Solomon.
text.WEB: Huram sent him ships and servants who had knowledge of the sea by the hands of his servants; and they came with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and brought from there four hundred fifty talents of gold, and brought them to king Solomon.

text.KJV: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, she came to prove Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem, with a very great company, and camels that bare spices, and gold in abundance, and precious stones: and when she was come to Solomon, she communed with him of all that was in her heart.
text.ASV: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, she came to prove Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem, with a very great train, and camels that bare spices, and gold in abundance, and precious stones: and when she was come to Solomon, she communed with him of all that was in her heart.
text.WEB: When the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, she came to test Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem, with a very great caravan, including camels that bore spices, gold in abundance, and precious stones. When she had come to Solomon, she talked with him about all that was in her heart.

text.KJV: And Solomon told her all her questions: and there was nothing hid from Solomon which he told her not.
text.ASV: And Solomon told her all her questions; and there was not anything hid from Solomon which he told her not.
text.WEB: Solomon answered all her questions. There wasn’t anything hidden from Solomon which he didn’t tell her.

text.KJV: And when the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon, and the house that he had built,
text.ASV: And when the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon, and the house that he had built,
text.WEB: When the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon, the house that he had built,

text.KJV: And the meat of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel; his cupbearers also, and their apparel; and his ascent by which he went up into the house of the LORD; there was no more spirit in her.
text.ASV: and the food of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel, his cupbearers also, and their apparel, and his ascent by which he went up unto the house of Jehovah; there was no more spirit in her.
text.WEB: the food of his table, the seating of his servants, the attendance of his ministers, their clothing, his cup bearers also, their clothing, and his ascent by which he went up to Yahweh’s house; there was no more spirit in her.

text.KJV: And she said to the king, It was a true report which I heard in mine own land of thine acts, and of thy wisdom:
text.ASV: And she said to the king, It was a true report that I heard in mine own land of thine acts, and of thy wisdom.
text.WEB: She said to the king, “It was a true report that I heard in my own land of your acts and of your wisdom.

text.KJV: Howbeit I believed not their words, until I came, and mine eyes had seen it: and, behold, the one half of the greatness of thy wisdom was not told me: for thou exceedest the fame that I heard.
text.ASV: Howbeit I believed not their words, until I came, and mine eyes had seen it; and, behold, the half of the greatness of thy wisdom was not told me: thou exceedest the fame that I heard.
text.WEB: However I didn’t believe their words until I came, and my eyes had seen it; and behold, the half of the greatness of your wisdom was not told me. You exceed the fame that I heard!

text.KJV: Happy are thy men, and happy are these thy servants, which stand continually before thee, and hear thy wisdom.
text.ASV: Happy are thy men, and happy are these thy servants, that stand continually before thee, and hear thy wisdom.
text.WEB: Happy are your men, and happy are these your servants, who stand continually before you, and hear your wisdom.

text.KJV: Blessed be the LORD thy God, which delighted in thee to set thee on his throne, to be king for the LORD thy God: because thy God loved Israel, to establish them for ever, therefore made he thee king over them, to do judgment and justice.
text.ASV: Blessed be Jehovah thy God, who delighted in thee, to set thee on his throne, to be king for Jehovah thy God: because thy God loved Israel, to establish them for ever, therefore made he thee king over them, to do justice and righteousness.
text.WEB: Blessed be Yahweh your God, who delighted in you, to set you on his throne, to be king for Yahweh your God; because your God loved Israel, to establish them forever. Therefore made he you king over them, to do justice and righteousness.”

text.KJV: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices great abundance, and precious stones: neither was there any such spice as the queen of Sheba gave king Solomon.
text.ASV: And she gave the king a hundred and twenty talents of gold, and spices in great abundance, and precious stones: neither was there any such spice as the queen of Sheba gave to king Solomon.
text.WEB: She gave the king one hundred and twenty talents of gold, spices in great abundance, and precious stones. There was never before such spice as the queen of Sheba gave to king Solomon.

text.KJV: And the servants also of Huram, and the servants of Solomon, which brought gold from Ophir, brought algum trees and precious stones.
text.ASV: And the servants also of Huram, and the servants of Solomon, that brought gold from Ophir, brought algum-trees and precious stones.
text.WEB: The servants of Huram and the servants of Solomon, who brought gold from Ophir, also brought algum trees and precious stones.

text.KJV: And the king made of the algum trees terraces to the house of the LORD, and to the king's palace, and harps and psalteries for singers: and there were none such seen before in the land of Judah.
text.ASV: And the king made of the algum-trees terraces for the house of Jehovah, and for the king's house, and harps and psalteries for the singers: and there were none such seen before in the land of Judah.
text.WEB: The king used algum tree wood to make terraces for Yahweh’s house and for the king’s house, and harps and stringed instruments for the singers. There were none like these seen before in the land of Judah.

text.KJV: And king Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, beside that which she had brought unto the king. So she turned, and went away to her own land, she and her servants.
text.ASV: And king Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, besides that which she had brought unto the king. So she turned, and went to her own land, she and her servants.
text.WEB: King Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatever she asked, besides that which she had brought to the king. So she turned, and went to her own land, she and her servants.

text.KJV: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred and threescore and six talents of gold;
text.ASV: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred and threescore and six talents of gold,
text.WEB: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred sixty-six talents of gold,

text.KJV: Beside that which chapmen and merchants brought. And all the kings of Arabia and governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon.
text.ASV: besides that which the traders and merchants brought: and all the kings of Arabia and the governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon.
text.WEB: besides that which the traders and merchants brought. All the kings of Arabia and the governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon.

text.KJV: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold: six hundred shekels of beaten gold went to one target.
text.ASV: And king Solomon made two hundred bucklers of beaten gold; six hundred `shekels' of beaten gold went to one buckler.
text.WEB: King Solomon made two hundred bucklers of beaten gold. Six hundred shekels of beaten gold went to one buckler.

text.KJV: And three hundred shields made he of beaten gold: three hundred shekels of gold went to one shield. And the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.
text.ASV: And `he made' three hundred shields of beaten gold; three hundred `shekels' of gold went to one shield: and the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.
text.WEB: He made three hundred shields of beaten gold. Three hundred shekels of gold went to one shield. The king put them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.

text.KJV: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with pure gold.
text.ASV: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with pure gold.
text.WEB: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with pure gold.

text.KJV: And there were six steps to the throne, with a footstool of gold, which were fastened to the throne, and stays on each side of the sitting place, and two lions standing by the stays:
text.ASV: nd there were six steps to the throne, with a footstool of gold, which were fastened to the throne, and stays on either side by the place of the seat, and two lions standing beside the stays.
text.WEB: There were six steps to the throne, with a footstool of gold, which were fastened to the throne, and armrests on either side by the place of the seat, and two lions standing beside the armrests.

text.KJV: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps. There was not the like made in any kingdom.
text.ASV: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps: there was not the like made in any kingdom.
text.WEB: Twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other on the six steps. There was nothing like it made in any other kingdom.

text.KJV: And all the drinking vessels of king Solomon were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold: none were of silver; it was not any thing accounted of in the days of Solomon.
text.ASV: And all king Solomon's drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold: silver was nothing accounted of in the days of Solomon.
text.WEB: All king Solomon’s drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the House of the Forest of Lebanon were of pure gold. Silver was not considered valuable in the days of Solomon.

text.KJV: For the king's ships went to Tarshish with the servants of Huram: every three years once came the ships of Tarshish bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.
text.ASV: For the king had ships that went to Tarshish with the servants of Huram; once every three years came the ships of Tarshish, bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.
text.WEB: For the king had ships that went to Tarshish with Huram’s servants. Once every three years, the ships of Tarshish came bringing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.

text.KJV: And king Solomon passed all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.
text.ASV: So king Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.
text.WEB: So king Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.

text.KJV: And all the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon, to hear his wisdom, that God had put in his heart.
text.ASV: And all the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon, to hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.
text.WEB: All the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon, to hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.

text.KJV: And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and raiment, harness, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.
text.ASV: And they brought every man his tribute, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and raiment, armor, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.
text.WEB: They each brought tribute, vessels of silver, vessels of gold, clothing, armor, spices, horses, and mules every year.

text.KJV: And Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen; whom he bestowed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.
text.ASV: And Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, that he bestowed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.
text.WEB: Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, that he stationed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.

text.KJV: And he reigned over all the kings from the river even unto the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt.
text.ASV: And he ruled over all the kings from the River even unto the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt.
text.WEB: He ruled over all the kings from the River even to the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt.

text.KJV: And the king made silver in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar trees made he as the sycamore trees that are in the low plains in abundance.
text.ASV: And the king made silver to be in Jerusalem as stones, and cedars made he to be as the sycomore-trees that are in the lowland, for abundance.
text.WEB: The king made silver as common in Jerusalem as stones, and he made cedars to be as abundant as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland.

text.KJV: And they brought unto Solomon horses out of Egypt, and out of all lands.
text.ASV: And they brought horses for Solomon out of Egypt, and out of all lands.
text.WEB: They brought horses for Solomon out of Egypt and out of all lands.

text.KJV: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, first and last, are they not written in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer against Jeroboam the son of Nebat?
text.ASV: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, first and last, are they not written in the history of Nathan the prophet, and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer concerning Jeroboam the son of Nebat?
text.WEB: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, first and last, aren’t they written in the history of Nathan the prophet, and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer concerning Jeroboam the son of Nebat?

text.KJV: And Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.
text.ASV: And Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.
text.WEB: Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.

text.KJV: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and he was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.
text.ASV: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and he was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.
text.WEB: Solomon slept with his fathers, and he was buried in his father David’s city: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his place.

text.KJV: And Rehoboam went to Shechem: for to Shechem were all Israel come to make him king.
text.ASV: And Rehoboam went to Shechem; for all Israel were come to Shechem to make him king.
text.WEB: Rehoboam went to Shechem; for all Israel had come to Shechem to make him king.

text.KJV: And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who was in Egypt, whither he fled from the presence of Solomon the king, heard it, that Jeroboam returned out of Egypt.
text.ASV: And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard of it, (for he was in Egypt, whither he had fled from the presence of king Solomon,) that Jeroboam returned out of Egypt.
text.WEB: When Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard of it (for he was in Egypt, where he had fled from the presence of king Solomon), Jeroboam returned out of Egypt.

text.KJV: And they sent and called him. So Jeroboam and all Israel came and spake to Rehoboam, saying,
text.ASV: And they sent and called him; and Jeroboam and all Israel came, and they spake to Rehoboam, saying,
text.WEB: They sent and called him; and Jeroboam and all Israel came, and they spoke to Rehoboam, saying,

text.KJV: Thy father made our yoke grievous: now therefore ease thou somewhat the grievous servitude of thy father, and his heavy yoke that he put upon us, and we will serve thee.
text.ASV: Thy father made our yoke grievous: now therefore make thou the grievous service of thy father, and his heavy yoke which he put upon us, lighter, and we will serve thee.
text.WEB: “Your father made our yoke grievous: now therefore make the grievous service of your father, and his heavy yoke which he put on us, lighter, and we will serve you.”

text.KJV: And he said unto them, Come again unto me after three days. And the people departed.
text.ASV: And he said unto them, Come again unto me after three days. And the people departed.
text.WEB: He said to them, “Come again to me after three days.” So the people departed.

text.KJV: And king Rehoboam took counsel with the old men that had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, What counsel give ye me to return answer to this people?
text.ASV: And king Rehoboam took counsel with the old men, that had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, What counsel give ye me to return answer to this people?
text.WEB: King Rehoboam took counsel with the old men, who had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, “What counsel do you give me about how to answer these people?”

text.KJV: And they spake unto him, saying, If thou be kind to this people, and please them, and speak good words to them, they will be thy servants for ever.
text.ASV: And they spake unto him, saying, If thou be kind to this people, and please them, and speak good words to them, then they will be thy servants for ever.
text.WEB: They spoke to him, saying, “If you are kind to these people, please them, and speak good words to them, then they will be your servants forever.”

text.KJV: But he forsook the counsel which the old men gave him, and took counsel with the young men that were brought up with him, that stood before him.
text.ASV: But he forsook the counsel of the old men which they had given him, and took counsel with the young men that were grown up with him, that stood before him.
text.WEB: But he abandoned the counsel of the old men which they had given him, and took counsel with the young men who had grown up with him, who stood before him.

text.KJV: And he said unto them, What advice give ye that we may return answer to this people, which have spoken to me, saying, Ease somewhat the yoke that thy father did put upon us?
text.ASV: And he said unto them, What counsel give ye, that we may return answer to this people, who have spoken to me, saying, Make the yoke that thy father did put upon us lighter?
text.WEB: He said to them, “What counsel do you give, that we may give an answer to these people, who have spoken to me, saying, ‘Make the yoke that your father put on us lighter?’”

text.KJV: And the young men that were brought up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shalt thou answer the people that spake unto thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, but make thou it somewhat lighter for us; thus shalt thou say unto them, My little finger shall be thicker than my father's loins.
text.ASV: And the young men that were grown up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shalt thou say unto the people that spake unto thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, but make thou it lighter unto us; thus shalt thou say unto them, My little finger is thicker than my father's loins.
text.WEB: The young men who had grown up with him spoke to him, saying, “Thus you shall tell the people who spoke to you, saying, ‘Your father made our yoke heavy, but make it lighter on us;’ thus you shall say to them, ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist.

text.KJV: For whereas my father put a heavy yoke upon you, I will put more to your yoke: my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.
text.ASV: And now whereas my father did lade you with a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke: my father chastised you with whips, but I `will chastise you' with scorpions.
text.WEB: Now whereas my father burdened you with a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.’”

text.KJV: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day, as the king bade, saying, Come again to me on the third day.
text.ASV: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king bade, saying, Come to me again the third day.
text.WEB: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king asked, saying, “Come to me again the third day.”

text.KJV: And the king answered them roughly; and king Rehoboam forsook the counsel of the old men,
text.ASV: And the king answered them roughly; and king Rehoboam forsook the counsel of the old men,
text.WEB: The king answered them roughly; and king Rehoboam abandoned the counsel of the old men,

text.KJV: And answered them after the advice of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add thereto: my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.
text.ASV: and spake to them after the counsel of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add thereto: my father chastised you with whips, but I `will chastise you' with scorpions.
text.WEB: and spoke to them after the counsel of the young men, saying, “My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add to it. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.”

text.KJV: So the king hearkened not unto the people: for the cause was of God, that the LORD might perform his word, which he spake by the hand of Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
text.ASV: So the king hearkened not unto the people; for it was brought about of God, that Jehovah might establish his word, which he spake by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
text.WEB: So the king didn’t listen to the people; for it was brought about by God, that Yahweh might establish his word, which he spoke by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

text.KJV: And when all Israel saw that the king would not hearken unto them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? and we have none inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to your tents, O Israel: and now, David, see to thine own house. So all Israel went to their tents.
text.ASV: And when all Israel saw that the king hearkened not unto them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to your tents, O Israel: now see to thine own house, David. So all Israel departed unto their tents.
text.WEB: When all Israel saw that the king didn’t listen to them, the people answered the king, saying, “What portion have we in David? We don’t have an inheritance in the son of Jesse! Every man to your tents, Israel! Now see to your own house, David.” So all Israel departed to their tents.

text.KJV: But as for the children of Israel that dwelt in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.
text.ASV: But as for the children of Israel that dwelt in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.
text.WEB: But as for the children of Israel who lived in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.

text.KJV: Then king Rehoboam sent Hadoram that was over the tribute; and the children of Israel stoned him with stones, that he died. But king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.
text.ASV: Then king Rehoboam sent Hadoram, who was over the men subject to taskwork; and the children of Israel stoned him to death with stones. And king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.
text.WEB: Then king Rehoboam sent Hadoram, who was over the men subject to forced labor; and the children of Israel stoned him to death with stones. King Rehoboam hurried to get himself up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.

text.KJV: And Israel rebelled against the house of David unto this day.
text.ASV: So Israel rebelled against the house of David unto this day.
text.WEB: So Israel rebelled against David’s house to this day.

text.KJV: And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, he gathered of the house of Judah and Benjamin an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men, which were warriors, to fight against Israel, that he might bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam.
text.ASV: And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, he assembled the house of Judah and Benjamin, a hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men, that were warriors, to fight against Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam.
text.WEB: When Rehoboam had come to Jerusalem, he assembled the house of Judah and Benjamin, one hundred eighty thousand chosen men who were warriors, to fight against Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam.

text.KJV: But the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,
text.ASV: But the word of Jehovah came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,
text.WEB: But Yahweh’s word came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,

text.KJV: Speak unto Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin, saying,
text.ASV: Speak unto Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin, saying,
text.WEB: “Speak to Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin, saying,

text.KJV: Thus saith the LORD, Ye shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren: return every man to his house: for this thing is done of me. And they obeyed the words of the LORD, and returned from going against Jeroboam.
text.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah, Ye shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren: return every man to his house; for this thing is of me. So they hearkened unto the words of Jehovah, and returned from going against Jeroboam.
text.WEB: ‘Yahweh says, “You shall not go up, nor fight against your brothers! Every man return to his house; for this thing is of me.”’” So they listened to Yahweh’s words, and returned from going against Jeroboam.

text.KJV: And Rehoboam dwelt in Jerusalem, and built cities for defense in Judah.
text.ASV: And Rehoboam dwelt in Jerusalem, and built cities for defence in Judah.
text.WEB: Rehoboam lived in Jerusalem, and built cities for defense in Judah.

text.KJV: He built even Bethlehem, and Etam, and Tekoa,
text.ASV: He built Beth-lehem, and Etam, and Tekoa,
text.WEB: He built Bethlehem, Etam, Tekoa,

text.KJV: And Bethzur, and Shoco, and Adullam,
text.ASV: And Beth-zur, and Soco, and Adullam,
text.WEB: Beth Zur, Soco, Adullam,

text.KJV: And Gath, and Mareshah, and Ziph,
text.ASV: and Gath, and Mareshah, and Ziph,
text.WEB: Gath, Mareshah, Ziph,

text.KJV: And Adoraim, and Lachish, and Azekah,
text.ASV: and Adoraim, and Lachish, and Azekah,
text.WEB: Adoraim, Lachish, Azekah,

text.KJV: And Zorah, and Aijalon, and Hebron, which are in Judah and in Benjamin fenced cities.
text.ASV: and Zorah, and Aijalon, and Hebron, which are in Judah and in Benjamin, fortified cities.
text.WEB: Zorah, Aijalon, and Hebron, which are fortified cities in Judah and in Benjamin.

text.KJV: And he fortified the strong holds, and put captains in them, and store of victual, and of oil and wine.
text.ASV: And he fortified the strongholds, and put captains in them, and stores of victuals, and oil and wine.
text.WEB: He fortified the strongholds, and put captains in them, and stores of food, oil and wine.

text.KJV: And in every several city he put shields and spears, and made them exceeding strong, having Judah and Benjamin on his side.
text.ASV: And in every city `he put' shields and spears, and made them exceeding strong. And Judah and Benjamin belonged to him.
text.WEB: He put shields and spears in every city, and made them exceedingly strong. Judah and Benjamin belonged to him.

text.KJV: And the priests and the Levites that were in all Israel resorted to him out of all their coasts.
text.ASV: And the priests and the Levites that were in all Israel resorted to him out of all their border.
text.WEB: The priests and the Levites who were in all Israel stood with him out of all their territory.

text.KJV: For the Levites left their suburbs and their possession, and came to Judah and Jerusalem: for Jeroboam and his sons had cast them off from executing the priest's office unto the LORD:
text.ASV: For the Levites left their suburbs and their possession, and came to Judah and Jerusalem: for Jeroboam and his sons cast them off, that they should not execute the priest's office unto Jehovah;
text.WEB: For the Levites left their suburbs and their possession, and came to Judah and Jerusalem; for Jeroboam and his sons cast them off, that they should not execute the priest’s office to Yahweh.

text.KJV: And he ordained him priests for the high places, and for the devils, and for the calves which he had made.
text.ASV: and he appointed him priests for the high places, and for the he-goats, and for the calves which he had made.
text.WEB: He himself appointed priests for the high places, for the male goats, and for the calves which he had made.

text.KJV: And after them out of all the tribes of Israel such as set their hearts to seek the LORD God of Israel came to Jerusalem, to sacrifice unto the LORD God of their fathers.
text.ASV: And after them, out of all the tribes of Israel, such as set their hearts to seek Jehovah, the God of Israel, came to Jerusalem to sacrifice unto Jehovah, the God of their fathers.
text.WEB: After them, out of all the tribes of Israel, those who set their hearts to seek Yahweh, the God of Israel, came to Jerusalem to sacrifice to Yahweh, the God of their fathers.

text.KJV: So they strengthened the kingdom of Judah, and made Rehoboam the son of Solomon strong, three years: for three years they walked in the way of David and Solomon.
text.ASV: So they strengthened the kingdom of Judah, and made Rehoboam the son of Solomon strong, three years; for they walked three years in the way of David and Solomon.
text.WEB: So they strengthened the kingdom of Judah, and made Rehoboam the son of Solomon strong for three years; for they walked three years in the way of David and Solomon.

text.KJV: And Rehoboam took him Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David to wife, and Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse;
text.ASV: And Rehoboam took him a wife, Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David, `and of' Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse;
text.WEB: Rehoboam took a wife for himself, Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David and of Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse.

text.KJV: Which bare him children; Jeush, and Shamariah, and Zaham.
text.ASV: and she bare him sons: Jeush, and Shemariah, and Zaham.
text.WEB: She bore him sons: Jeush, Shemariah, and Zaham.

text.KJV: And after her he took Maachah the daughter of Absalom; which bare him Abijah, and Attai, and Ziza, and Shelomith.
text.ASV: And after her he took Maacah the daughter of Absalom; and she bare him Abijah, and Attai, and Ziza, and Shelomith.
text.WEB: After her, he took Maacah the daughter of Absalom; and she bore him Abijah, Attai, Ziza, and Shelomith.

text.KJV: And Rehoboam loved Maachah the daughter of Absalom above all his wives and his concubines: (for he took eighteen wives, and threescore concubines; and begat twenty and eight sons, and threescore daughters.)
text.ASV: And Rehoboam loved Maacah the daughter of Absalom above all his wives and his concubines: (for he took eighteen wives, and threescore concubines, and begat twenty and eight sons and threescore daughters.)
text.WEB: Rehoboam loved Maacah the daughter of Absalom above all his wives and his concubines; for he took eighteen wives and sixty concubines, and became the father of twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters.

text.KJV: And Rehoboam made Abijah the son of Maachah the chief, to be ruler among his brethren: for he thought to make him king.
text.ASV: And Rehoboam appointed Abijah the son of Maacah to be chief, `even' the prince among his brethren; for `he was minded' to make him king.
text.WEB: Rehoboam appointed Abijah the son of Maacah to be chief, the prince among his brothers; for he intended to make him king.

text.KJV: And he dealt wisely, and dispersed of all his children throughout all the countries of Judah and Benjamin, unto every fenced city: and he gave them victual in abundance. And he desired many wives.
text.ASV: And he dealt wisely, and dispersed of all his sons throughout all the lands of Judah and Benjamin, unto every fortified city: and he gave them victuals in abundance. And he sought `for them' many wives.
text.WEB: He dealt wisely, and dispersed of all his sons throughout all the lands of Judah and Benjamin, to every fortified city. He gave them food in abundance and he sought many wives for them.

text.KJV: And it came to pass, when Rehoboam had established the kingdom, and had strengthened himself, he forsook the law of the LORD, and all Israel with him.
text.ASV: And it came to pass, when the kingdom of Rehoboam was established, and he was strong, that he forsook the law of Jehovah, and all Israel with him.
text.WEB: When the kingdom of Rehoboam was established and he was strong, he abandoned Yahweh’s law, and all Israel with him.

text.KJV: And it came to pass, that in the fifth year of king Rehoboam Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, because they had transgressed against the LORD,
text.ASV: And it came to pass in the fifth year of king Rehoboam, that Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, because they had trespassed against Jehovah,
text.WEB: In the fifth year of king Rehoboam, Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, because they had trespassed against Yahweh,

text.KJV: With twelve hundred chariots, and threescore thousand horsemen: and the people were without number that came with him out of Egypt; the Lubims, the Sukkiims, and the Ethiopians.
text.ASV: with twelve hundred chariots, and threescore thousand horsemen. And the people were without number that came with him out of Egypt: the Lubim, the Sukkiim, and the Ethiopians.
text.WEB: with twelve hundred chariots, and sixty thousand horsemen. The people were without number who came with him out of Egypt: the Lubim, the Sukkiim, and the Ethiopians.

text.KJV: And he took the fenced cities which pertained to Judah, and came to Jerusalem.
text.ASV: And he took the fortified cities which pertained to Judah, and came unto Jerusalem.
text.WEB: He took the fortified cities which belonged to Judah, and came to Jerusalem.

text.KJV: Then came Shemaiah the prophet to Rehoboam, and to the princes of Judah, that were gathered together to Jerusalem because of Shishak, and said unto them, Thus saith the LORD, Ye have forsaken me, and therefore have I also left you in the hand of Shishak.
text.ASV: Now Shemaiah the prophet came to Rehoboam, and to the princes of Judah, that were gathered together to Jerusalem because of Shishak, and said unto them, Thus saith Jehovah, Ye have forsaken me, therefore have I also left you in the hand of Shishak.
text.WEB: Now Shemaiah the prophet came to Rehoboam, and to the princes of Judah, who were gathered together to Jerusalem because of Shishak, and said to them, “Yahweh says, ‘You have forsaken me, therefore I have also left you in the hand of Shishak.’”

text.KJV: Whereupon the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves; and they said, The LORD is righteous.
text.ASV: Then the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves; and they said, Jehovah is righteous.
text.WEB: Then the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves; and they said, “Yahweh is righteous.”

text.KJV: And when the LORD saw that they humbled themselves, the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah, saying, They have humbled themselves; therefore I will not destroy them, but I will grant them some deliverance; and my wrath shall not be poured out upon Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak.
text.ASV: And when Jehovah saw that they humbled themselves, the word of Jehovah came to Shemaiah, saying, They have humbled themselves: I will not destroy them; but I will grant them some deliverance, and my wrath shall not be poured out upon Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak.
text.WEB: When Yahweh saw that they humbled themselves, Yahweh’s word came to Shemaiah, saying, “They have humbled themselves. I will not destroy them; but I will grant them some deliverance, and my wrath won’t be poured out on Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak.

text.KJV: Nevertheless they shall be his servants; that they may know my service, and the service of the kingdoms of the countries.
text.ASV: Nevertheless they shall be his servants, that they may know my service, and the service of the kingdoms of the countries.
text.WEB: Nevertheless they will be his servants, that they may know my service, and the service of the kingdoms of the countries.”

text.KJV: So Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, and took away the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king's house; he took all: he carried away also the shields of gold which Solomon had made.
text.ASV: So Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, and took away the treasures of the house of Jehovah, and the treasures of the king's house: he took all away: he took away also the shields of gold which Solomon had made.
text.WEB: So Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem and took away the treasures of Yahweh’s house and the treasures of the king’s house. He took it all away. He also took away the shields of gold which Solomon had made.

text.KJV: Instead of which king Rehoboam made shields of brass, and committed them to the hands of the chief of the guard, that kept the entrance of the king's house.
text.ASV: And king Rehoboam made in their stead shields of brass, and committed them to the hands of the captains of the guard, that kept the door of the king's house.
text.WEB: King Rehoboam made shields of brass in their place, and committed them to the hands of the captains of the guard, who kept the door of the king’s house.

text.KJV: And when the king entered into the house of the LORD, the guard came and fetched them, and brought them again into the guard chamber.
text.ASV: And it was so, that, as oft as the king entered into the house of Jehovah, the guard came and bare them, and brought them back into the guard-chamber.
text.WEB: As often as the king entered into Yahweh’s house, the guard came and bore them, then brought them back into the guard room.

text.KJV: And when he humbled himself, the wrath of the LORD turned from him, that he would not destroy him altogether: and also in Judah things went well.
text.ASV: And when he humbled himself, the wrath of Jehovah turned from him, so as not to destroy him altogether: and moreover in Judah there were good things `found'.
text.WEB: When he humbled himself, Yahweh’s wrath turned from him, so as not to destroy him altogether. Moreover, there were good things found in Judah.

text.KJV: So king Rehoboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem, and reigned: for Rehoboam was one and forty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the LORD had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there. And his mother's name was Naamah an Ammonitess.
text.ASV: So king Rehoboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem, and reigned: for Rehoboam was forty and one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which Jehovah had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there: and his mother's name was Naamah the Ammonitess.
text.WEB: So king Rehoboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem and reigned; for Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which Yahweh had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel to put his name there. His mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonitess.

text.KJV: And he did evil, because he prepared not his heart to seek the LORD.
text.ASV: And he did that which was evil, because he set not his heart to seek Jehovah.
text.WEB: He did that which was evil, because he didn’t set his heart to seek Yahweh.

text.KJV: Now the acts of Rehoboam, first and last, are they not written in the book of Shemaiah the prophet, and of Iddo the seer concerning genealogies? And there were wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.
text.ASV: Now the acts of Rehoboam, first and last, are they not written in the histories of Shemaiah the prophet and of Iddo the seer, after the manner of genealogies? And there were wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.
text.WEB: Now the acts of Rehoboam, first and last, aren’t they written in the histories of Shemaiah the prophet and of Iddo the seer, in the genealogies? There were wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.

text.KJV: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David: and Abijah his son reigned in his stead.
text.ASV: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David: and Abijah his son reigned in his stead.
text.WEB: Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried in David’s city; and Abijah his son reigned in his place.

text.KJV: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam began Abijah to reign over Judah.
text.ASV: In the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam began Abijah to reign over Judah.
text.WEB: In the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam, Abijah began to reign over Judah.

text.KJV: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also was Michaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.
text.ASV: Three years reigned he in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Micaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.
text.WEB: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Micaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. There was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.

text.KJV: And Abijah set the battle in array with an army of valiant men of war, even four hundred thousand chosen men: Jeroboam also set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men, being mighty men of valor.
text.ASV: And Abijah joined battle with an army of valiant men of war, even four hundred thousand chosen men: and Jeroboam set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men, who were mighty men of valor.
text.WEB: Abijah joined battle with an army of valiant men of war, even four hundred thousand chosen men; and Jeroboam set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men, who were mighty men of valor.

text.KJV: And Abijah stood up upon mount Zemaraim, which is in mount Ephraim, and said, Hear me, thou Jeroboam, and all Israel;
text.ASV: And Abijah stood up upon mount Zemaraim, which is in the hill-country of Ephraim, and said, Hear me, O Jeroboam and all Israel:
text.WEB: Abijah stood up on Mount Zemaraim, which is in the hill country of Ephraim, and said, “Hear me, Jeroboam and all Israel:

text.KJV: Ought ye not to know that the LORD God of Israel gave the kingdom over Israel to David for ever, even to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt?
text.ASV: Ought ye not to know that Jehovah, the God of Israel, gave the kingdom over Israel to David for ever, even to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt?
text.WEB: Ought you not to know that Yahweh, the God of Israel, gave the kingdom over Israel to David forever, even to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt?

text.KJV: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon the son of David, is risen up, and hath rebelled against his lord.
text.ASV: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon the son of David, rose up, and rebelled against his lord.
text.WEB: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon the son of David, rose up, and rebelled against his lord.

text.KJV: And there are gathered unto him vain men, the children of Belial, and have strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the son of Solomon, when Rehoboam was young and tenderhearted, and could not withstand them.
text.ASV: And there were gathered unto him worthless men, base fellows, that strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the son of Solomon, when Rehoboam was young and tender-hearted, and could not withstand them.
text.WEB: Worthless men were gathered to him, wicked fellows who strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the son of Solomon, when Rehoboam was young and tender hearted, and could not withstand them.

text.KJV: And now ye think to withstand the kingdom of the LORD in the hand of the sons of David; and ye be a great multitude, and there are with your golden calves, which Jeroboam made you for gods.
text.ASV: And now ye think to withstand the kingdom of Jehovah in the hand of the sons of David; and ye are a great multitude, and there are with you the golden calves which Jeroboam made you for gods.
text.WEB: “Now you intend to withstand the kingdom of Yahweh in the hand of the sons of David. You are a great multitude, and the golden calves which Jeroboam made you for gods are with you.

text.KJV: Have ye not cast out the priests of the LORD, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and have made you priests after the manner of the nations of other lands? so that whosoever cometh to consecrate himself with a young bullock and seven rams, the same may be a priest of them that are no gods.
text.ASV: Have ye not driven out the priests of Jehovah, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and made you priests after the manner of the peoples of `other' lands? so that whosoever cometh to consecrate himself with a young bullock and seven rams, the same may be a priest of `them that are' no gods.
text.WEB: Haven’t you driven out the priests of Yahweh, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and made priests for yourselves according to the ways of the peoples of other lands? Whoever comes to consecrate himself with a young bull and seven rams may be a priest of those who are no gods.

text.KJV: But as for us, the LORD is our God, and we have not forsaken him; and the priests, which minister unto the LORD, are the sons of Aaron, and the Levites wait upon their business:
text.ASV: But as for us, Jehovah is our God, and we have not forsaken him; and `we have' priests ministering unto Jehovah, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites in their work:
text.WEB: “But as for us, Yahweh is our God, and we have not forsaken him. We have priests serving Yahweh, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites in their work;

text.KJV: And they burn unto the LORD every morning and every evening burnt sacrifices and sweet incense: the shewbread also set they in order upon the pure table; and the candlestick of gold with the lamps thereof, to burn every evening: for we keep the charge of the LORD our God; but ye have forsaken him.
text.ASV: and they burn unto Jehovah every morning and every evening burnt-offerings and sweet incense: the showbread also `set they' in order upon the pure table; and the candlestick of gold with the lamps thereof, to burn every evening: for we keep the charge of Jehovah our God; but ye have forsaken him.
text.WEB: and they burn to Yahweh every morning and every evening burnt offerings and sweet incense. They also set the show bread in order on the pure table; and the lamp stand of gold with its lamps, to burn every evening; for we keep the instruction of Yahweh our God, but you have forsaken him.

text.KJV: And, behold, God himself is with us for our captain, and his priests with sounding trumpets to cry alarm against you. O children of Israel, fight ye not against the LORD God of your fathers; for ye shall not prosper.
text.ASV: And, behold, God is with us at our head, and his priests with the trumpets of alarm to sound an alarm against you. O children of Israel, fight ye not against Jehovah, the God of your fathers; for ye shall not prosper.
text.WEB: Behold, God is with us at our head, and his priests with the trumpets of alarm to sound an alarm against you. Children of Israel, don’t fight against Yahweh, the God of your fathers; for you will not prosper.”

text.KJV: But Jeroboam caused an ambushment to come about behind them: so they were before Judah, and the ambushment was behind them.
text.ASV: But Jeroboam caused an ambushment to come about behind them: so they were before Judah, and the ambushment was behind them.
text.WEB: But Jeroboam caused an ambush to come about behind them; so they were before Judah, and the ambush was behind them.

text.KJV: And when Judah looked back, behold, the battle was before and behind: and they cried unto the LORD, and the priests sounded with the trumpets.
text.ASV: And when Judah looked back, behold, the battle was before and behind them; and they cried unto Jehovah, and the priests sounded with the trumpets.
text.WEB: When Judah looked back, behold, the battle was before and behind them; and they cried to Yahweh, and the priests sounded with the trumpets.

text.KJV: Then the men of Judah gave a shout: and as the men of Judah shouted, it came to pass, that God smote Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.
text.ASV: Then the men of Judah gave a shout: and as the men of Judah shouted, it came to pass, that God smote Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.
text.WEB: Then the men of Judah gave a shout. As the men of Judah shouted, God struck Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.

text.KJV: And the children of Israel fled before Judah: and God delivered them into their hand.
text.ASV: And the children of Israel fled before Judah; and God delivered them into their hand.
text.WEB: The children of Israel fled before Judah, and God delivered them into their hand.

text.KJV: And Abijah and his people slew them with a great slaughter: so there fell down slain of Israel five hundred thousand chosen men.
text.ASV: And Abijah and his people slew them with a great slaughter: so there fell down slain of Israel five hundred thousand chosen men.
text.WEB: Abijah and his people killed them with a great slaughter, so five hundred thousand chosen men of Israel fell down slain.

text.KJV: Thus the children of Israel were brought under at that time, and the children of Judah prevailed, because they relied upon the LORD God of their fathers.
text.ASV: Thus the children of Israel were brought under at that time, and the children of Judah prevailed, because they relied upon Jehovah, the God of their fathers.
text.WEB: Thus the children of Israel were brought under at that time, and the children of Judah prevailed, because they relied on Yahweh, the God of their fathers.

text.KJV: And Abijah pursued after Jeroboam, and took cities from him, Bethel with the towns thereof, and Jeshanah with the towns thereof, and Ephraim with the towns thereof.
text.ASV: And Abijah pursued after Jeroboam, and took cities from him, Beth-el with the towns thereof, and Jeshanah with the towns thereof, and Ephron with the towns thereof.
text.WEB: Abijah pursued Jeroboam, and took cities from him, Bethel with its villages, Jeshanah with its villages, and Ephron with its villages.

text.KJV: Neither did Jeroboam recover strength again in the days of Abijah: and the LORD struck him, and he died.
text.ASV: Neither did Jeroboam recover strength again in the days of Abijah: and Jehovah smote him, and he died.
text.WEB: Jeroboam didn’t recover strength again in the days of Abijah. Yahweh struck him, and he died.

text.KJV: But Abijah waxed mighty, and married fourteen wives, and begat twenty and two sons, and sixteen daughters.
text.ASV: But Abijah waxed mighty, and took unto himself fourteen wives, and begat twenty and two sons, and sixteen daughters.
text.WEB: But Abijah grew mighty, and took for himself fourteen wives, and became the father of twenty-two sons, and sixteen daughters.

text.KJV: And the rest of the acts of Abijah, and his ways, and his sayings, are written in the story of the prophet Iddo.
text.ASV: And the rest of the acts of Abijah, and his ways, and his sayings, are written in the commentary of the prophet Iddo.
text.WEB: The rest of the acts of Abijah, his ways, and his sayings are written in the commentary of the prophet Iddo.

text.KJV: So Abijah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David: and Asa his son reigned in his stead. In his days the land was quiet ten years.
text.ASV: So Abijah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David; and Asa his son reigned in his stead. In his days the land was quiet ten years.
text.WEB: So Abijah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in David’s city; and Asa his son reigned in his place. In his days, the land was quiet ten years.

text.KJV: And Asa did that which was good and right in the eyes of the LORD his God:
text.ASV: And Asa did that which was good and right in the eyes of Jehovah his God:
text.WEB: Asa did that which was good and right in Yahweh his God’s eyes;

text.KJV: For he took away the altars of the strange gods, and the high places, and brake down the images, and cut down the groves:
text.ASV: for he took away the foreign altars, and the high places, and brake down the pillars, and hewed down the Asherim,
text.WEB: for he took away the foreign altars and the high places, broke down the pillars, cut down the Asherah poles,

text.KJV: And commanded Judah to seek the LORD God of their fathers, and to do the law and the commandment.
text.ASV: and commanded Judah to seek Jehovah, the God of their fathers, and to do the law and the commandment.
text.WEB: and commanded Judah to seek Yahweh, the God of their fathers, and to obey his law and command.

text.KJV: Also he took away out of all the cities of Judah the high places and the images: and the kingdom was quiet before him.
text.ASV: Also he took away out of all the cities of Judah the high places and the sun-images: and the kingdom was quiet before him.
text.WEB: Also he took away out of all the cities of Judah the high places and the sun images; and the kingdom was quiet before him.

text.KJV: And he built fenced cities in Judah: for the land had rest, and he had no war in those years; because the LORD had given him rest.
text.ASV: And he built fortified cities in Judah; for the land was quiet, and he had no war in those years, because Jehovah had given him rest.
text.WEB: He built fortified cities in Judah; for the land was quiet, and he had no war in those years, because Yahweh had given him rest.

text.KJV: Therefore he said unto Judah, Let us build these cities, and make about them walls, and towers, gates, and bars, while the land is yet before us; because we have sought the LORD our God, we have sought him, and he hath given us rest on every side. So they built and prospered.
text.ASV: For he said unto Judah, Let us build these cities, and make about them walls, and towers, gates, and bars; the land is yet before us, because we have sought Jehovah our God; we have sought him, and he hath given us rest on every side. So they built and prospered.
text.WEB: For he said to Judah, “Let us build these cities, and make walls around them, with towers, gates, and bars. The land is yet before us, because we have sought Yahweh our God. We have sought him, and he has given us rest on every side.” So they built and prospered.

text.KJV: And Asa had an army of men that bare targets and spears, out of Judah three hundred thousand; and out of Benjamin, that bare shields and drew bows, two hundred and fourscore thousand: all these were mighty men of valor.
text.ASV: And Asa had an army that bare bucklers and spears, out of Judah three hundred thousand; and out of Benjamin, that bare shields and drew bows, two hundred and fourscore thousand: all these were mighty men of valor.
text.WEB: Asa had an army of three hundred thousand out of Judah who bore bucklers and spears, and two hundred eighty thousand out of Benjamin who bore shields and drew bows. All these were mighty men of valor.

text.KJV: And there came out against them Zerah the Ethiopian with an host of a thousand thousand, and three hundred chariots; and came unto Mareshah.
text.ASV: And there came out against them Zerah the Ethiopian with an army of a thousand thousand, and three hundred chariots; and he came unto Mareshah.
text.WEB: Zerah the Ethiopian came out against them with an army of a million troops and three hundred chariots, and he came to Mareshah.

text.KJV: Then Asa went out against him, and they set the battle in array in the valley of Zephathah at Mareshah.
text.ASV: Then Asa went out to meet him, and they set the battle in array in the valley of Zephathah at Mareshah.
text.WEB: Then Asa went out to meet him, and they set the battle in array in the valley of Zephathah at Mareshah.

text.KJV: And Asa cried unto the LORD his God, and said, LORD, it is nothing with thee to help, whether with many, or with them that have no power: help us, O LORD our God; for we rest on thee, and in thy name we go against this multitude. O LORD, thou art our God; let no man prevail against thee.
text.ASV: And Asa cried unto Jehovah his God, and said, Jehovah, there is none besides thee to help, between the mighty and him that hath no strength: help us, O Jehovah our God; for we rely on thee, and in thy name are we come against this multitude. O Jehovah, thou art our God; let not man prevail against thee.
text.WEB: Asa cried to Yahweh his God, and said, “Yahweh, there is no one besides you to help, between the mighty and him who has no strength. Help us, Yahweh our God; for we rely on you, and in your name are we come against this multitude. Yahweh, you are our God. Don’t let man prevail against you.”

text.KJV: So the LORD smote the Ethiopians before Asa, and before Judah; and the Ethiopians fled.
text.ASV: So Jehovah smote the Ethiopians before Asa, and before Judah; and the Ethiopians fled.
text.WEB: So Yahweh struck the Ethiopians before Asa and before Judah; and the Ethiopians fled.

text.KJV: And Asa and the people that were with him pursued them unto Gerar: and the Ethiopians were overthrown, that they could not recover themselves; for they were destroyed before the LORD, and before his host; and they carried away very much spoil.
text.ASV: And Asa and the people that were with him pursued them unto Gerar: and there fell of the Ethiopians so many that they could not recover themselves; for they were destroyed before Jehovah, and before his host; and they carried away very much booty.
text.WEB: Asa and the people who were with him pursued them to Gerar: and so many of the Ethiopians fell that they could not recover themselves; for they were destroyed before Yahweh and before his army; and they carried away very much booty.

text.KJV: And they smote all the cities round about Gerar; for the fear of the LORD came upon them: and they spoiled all the cities; for there was exceeding much spoil in them.
text.ASV: And they smote all the cities round about Gerar; for the fear of Jehovah came upon them: and they despoiled all the cities; for there was much spoil in them.
text.WEB: They struck all the cities around Gerar; for the fear of Yahweh came on them, and they plundered all the cities; for there was much plunder in them.

text.KJV: They smote also the tents of cattle, and carried away sheep and camels in abundance, and returned to Jerusalem.
text.ASV: They smote also the tents of cattle, and carried away sheep in abundance, and camels, and returned to Jerusalem.
text.WEB: They also struck the tents of livestock, and carried away sheep in abundance, and camels, and returned to Jerusalem.

text.KJV: And the Spirit of God came upon Azariah the son of Oded:
text.ASV: And the Spirit of God came upon Azariah the son of Oded:
text.WEB: The Spirit of God came on Azariah the son of Oded:

text.KJV: And he went out to meet Asa, and said unto him, Hear ye me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin; The LORD is with you, while ye be with him; and if ye seek him, he will be found of you; but if ye forsake him, he will forsake you.
text.ASV: and he went out to meet Asa, and said unto him, Hear ye me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin: Jehovah is with you, while ye are with him; and if ye seek him, he will be found of you; but if ye forsake him, he will forsake you.
text.WEB: and he went out to meet Asa, and said to him, “Hear me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin! Yahweh is with you, while you are with him; and if you seek him, he will be found by you; but if you forsake him, he will forsake you.

text.KJV: Now for a long season Israel hath been without the true God, and without a teaching priest, and without law.
text.ASV: Now for a long season Israel was without the true God, and without a teaching priest, and without law:
text.WEB: Now for a long time Israel was without the true God, without a teaching priest, and without law.

text.KJV: But when they in their trouble did turn unto the LORD God of Israel, and sought him, he was found of them.
text.ASV: But when in their distress they turned unto Jehovah, the God of Israel, and sought him, he was found of them.
text.WEB: But when in their distress they turned to Yahweh, the God of Israel, and sought him, he was found by them.

text.KJV: And in those times there was no peace to him that went out, nor to him that came in, but great vexations were upon all the inhabitants of the countries.
text.ASV: And in those times there was no peace to him that went out, nor to him that came in; but great vexations were upon all the inhabitants of the lands.
text.WEB: In those times there was no peace to him who went out, nor to him who came in; but great troubles were on all the inhabitants of the lands.

text.KJV: And nation was destroyed of nation, and city of city: for God did vex them with all adversity.
text.ASV: And they were broken in pieces, nation against nation, and city against city; for God did vex them with all adversity.
text.WEB: They were broken in pieces, nation against nation, and city against city; for God troubled them with all adversity.

text.KJV: Be ye strong therefore, and let not your hands be weak: for your work shall be rewarded.
text.ASV: But be ye strong, and let not your hands be slack; for your work shall be rewarded.
text.WEB: But you be strong, and don’t let your hands be slack; for your work will be rewarded.”

text.KJV: And when Asa heard these words, and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he took courage, and put away the abominable idols out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and out of the cities which he had taken from mount Ephraim, and renewed the altar of the LORD, that was before the porch of the LORD.
text.ASV: And when Asa heard these words, and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he took courage, and put away the abominations out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and out of the cities which he had taken from the hill-country of Ephraim; and he renewed the altar of Jehovah, that was before the porch of Jehovah.
text.WEB: When Asa heard these words, and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he took courage, and put away the abominations out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and out of the cities which he had taken from the hill country of Ephraim; and he renewed Yahweh’s altar that was before Yahweh’s porch.

text.KJV: And he gathered all Judah and Benjamin, and the strangers with them out of Ephraim and Manasseh, and out of Simeon: for they fell to him out of Israel in abundance, when they saw that the LORD his God was with him.
text.ASV: And he gathered all Judah and Benjamin, and them that sojourned with them out of Ephraim and Manasseh, and out of Simeon: for they fell to him out of Israel in abundance, when they saw that Jehovah his God was with him.
text.WEB: He gathered all Judah and Benjamin, and those who lived with them out of Ephraim, Manasseh, and Simeon; for they came to him out of Israel in abundance when they saw that Yahweh his God was with him.

text.KJV: So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa.
text.ASV: So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa.
text.WEB: So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of Asa’s reign.

text.KJV: And they offered unto the LORD the same time, of the spoil which they had brought, seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep.
text.ASV: And they sacrificed unto Jehovah in that day, of the spoil which they had brought, seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep.
text.WEB: They sacrificed to Yahweh in that day, of the plunder which they had brought, seven hundred head of cattle and seven thousand sheep.

text.KJV: And they entered into a covenant to seek the LORD God of their fathers with all their heart and with all their soul;
text.ASV: And they entered into the covenant to seek Jehovah, the God of their fathers, with all their heart and with all their soul;
text.WEB: They entered into the covenant to seek Yahweh, the God of their fathers, with all their heart and with all their soul;

text.KJV: That whosoever would not seek the LORD God of Israel should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.
text.ASV: and that whosoever would not seek Jehovah, the God of Israel, should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.
text.WEB: and that whoever would not seek Yahweh, the God of Israel, should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.

text.KJV: And they sware unto the LORD with a loud voice, and with shouting, and with trumpets, and with cornets.
text.ASV: And they sware unto Jehovah with a loud voice, and with shouting, and with trumpets, and with cornets.
text.WEB: They swore to Yahweh with a loud voice, with shouting, with trumpets, and with cornets.

text.KJV: And all Judah rejoiced at the oath: for they had sworn with all their heart, and sought him with their whole desire; and he was found of them: and the LORD gave them rest round about.
text.ASV: And all Judah rejoiced at the oath; for they had sworn with all their heart, and sought him with their whole desire; and he was found of them: and Jehovah gave them rest round about.
text.WEB: All Judah rejoiced at the oath, for they had sworn with all their heart, and sought him with their whole desire; and he was found by them. Then Yahweh gave them rest all around.

text.KJV: And also concerning Maachah the mother of Asa the king, he removed her from being queen, because she had made an idol in a grove: and Asa cut down her idol, and stamped it, and burnt it at the brook Kidron.
text.ASV: And also Maacah, the mother of Asa the king, he removed from being queen, because she had made an abominable image for an Asherah; and Asa cut down her image, and made dust of it, and burnt it at the brook Kidron.
text.WEB: Also Maacah, the mother of Asa the king, he removed from being queen, because she had made an abominable image for an Asherah; so Asa cut down her image, ground it into dust, and burned it at the brook Kidron.

text.KJV: But the high places were not taken away out of Israel: nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days.
text.ASV: But the high places were not taken away out of Israel: nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days.
text.WEB: But the high places were not taken away out of Israel; nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days.

text.KJV: And he brought into the house of God the things that his father had dedicated, and that he himself had dedicated, silver, and gold, and vessels.
text.ASV: And he brought into the house of God the things that his father had dedicated, and that he himself had dedicated, silver, and gold, and vessels.
text.WEB: He brought the things that his father had dedicated, and that he himself had dedicated, silver, gold, and vessels into God’s house.

text.KJV: And there was no more war unto the five and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa.
text.ASV: And there was no more war unto the five and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa.
text.WEB: There was no more war to the thirty-fifth year of Asa’s reign.

text.KJV: In the six and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa Baasha king of Israel came up against Judah, and built Ramah, to the intent that he might let none go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.
text.ASV: In the six and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa, Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not suffer any one to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.
text.WEB: In the thirty-sixth year of Asa’s reign, Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not allow anyone to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.

text.KJV: Then Asa brought out silver and gold out of the treasures of the house of the LORD and of the king's house, and sent to Benhadad king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,
text.ASV: Then Asa brought out silver and gold out of the treasures of the house of Jehovah and of the king's house, and sent to Ben-hadad king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,
text.WEB: Then Asa brought out silver and gold out of the treasures of Yahweh’s house and of the king’s house, and sent to Ben Hadad king of Syria, who lived at Damascus, saying,
